items.title: Three Snowmen in Winter Hats
items.alt: Three different snowmen in green, plum and yellow winter hats standing together with scarves and raised mittens.
items.description: A tall narrow figure, a rounded companion and a tiny snowman form a cheerful family-sized grouping.

items.title: Snowman with a Mitten-Carrying Puppy
items.alt: Smiling snowman in a cream hood and navy scarf beside a shaggy brown puppy holding a red mitten in its mouth.
items.description: The puppy sits close to the snowman's rounded feet, with its mitten and the character's tilted head creating a small winter friendship scene.

items.title: Snowman with a Kitten on Its Hat
items.alt: Snowman with a berry scarf standing beneath a sleeping gray kitten curled on the brim of a navy top hat.
items.description: Folded twig hands and a slightly tilted face keep the character still while the kitten rests above.

items.title: Snowman and Penguin Sharing a Scarf
items.alt: Tall snowman and small penguin wrapped together in one red and cream striped scarf, with green mittens and a knit cap.
items.description: The snowman lifts one mitten while the penguin leans close with a happy expression and one orange foot raised.

items.title: Snowman beneath a Candy Cane Arch
items.alt: Small snowman in a blue pom-pom cap and mustard scarf stepping beneath a red and white candy cane arch.
items.description: The curved striped arch frames the open-armed character, with holly leaves and berries at the top.

items.title: Snowman Chef with a Mixing Bowl
items.alt: Snowman in a white chef hat and red apron holding a wooden spoon and a green mixing bowl.
items.description: A blue neckerchief and simple button face complete this friendly baking character.
